name: Ray Grid Traversal with Adaptive Step Sizing
aliases: Ray Traversal through Multiple Voxel Grids
definition: A GPU kernel that traverses a ray through a sparse voxel grid (binary occupancy) to generate sample points and interval boundaries. It handles empty cells by skipping them and fills continuous segments, supporting both fixed step sizes and cone-angle-aware adaptive stepping.
summary: A CUDA kernel that marches rays through voxel grids using precomputed intersections to skip empty cells and generate samples with distance-adaptive step sizes.
